name: GCP Secret Manager
label: Google Secret Manager API v1
description: Secret Manager API v1 via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://cloud.google.com/secret-manager/docs/reference/rest. Operations: access-secret-version, add-secret-version, create-secret, get-secret, list-secrets, destroy-secret-version, delete-secret, listen. Auth secret access_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). GET/access operations still call the official GET (or access) HTTP method. Retrieved secret material must not be logged and should stay in StudioQuack secret bindings (bind OUTPUT `data` into a secret; do not print it, persist it in engine variables, or leave it on a logged edge). listen is kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_token here. Path params match api_spec.json placeholders. Example: {"operation":"access-secret-version"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: access-secret-version | add-secret-version | create-secret | get-secret | list-secrets | destroy-secret-version | delete-secret | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen is ingress: no HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'access-secret-version'.

schema.label: secretId
schema.description: Secret id path segment (not the payload).

schema.label: version
schema.description: Version id or latest for access/destroy.

schema.label: payload
schema.description: Full SecretPayload escape hatch for add-secret-version: {data, dataCrc32c}. Used when INPUT data is empty. Official request.payload.

schema.label: replication
schema.description: create-secret replication policy. Official: {"automatic":{}} or {"userManaged":{"replicas":[{"location":"us-central1"}]}}. Required by the API for create-secret.

schema.label: etag
schema.description: Query-string/request-body parameter `etag` for operations: destroy-secret-version, delete-secret.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Secret bytes for add-secret-version, base64-encoded, max 64 KiB. Nested to payload.data. Official SecretPayload.data. Example: c2VjcmV0. Keep payload as the full SecretPayload object when you already have one.

schema.label: dataCrc32c
schema.description: Optional CRC32C of the raw (not base64) secret bytes, decimal int64 string. Nested to payload.dataCrc32c. Example: 163439259.

schema.label: ttl
schema.description: create-secret time-to-live duration (e.g. 86400s). Official Secret.ttl. Mutually exclusive with expireTime.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Secret bytes in data must not be logged; bind them into StudioQuack secrets. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON from the official API. May contain secret material — never log; bind into StudioQuack secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: access-secret-version, add-secret-version, create-secret, get-secret, list-secrets, destroy-secret-version, delete-secret, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth 2.0 access token (cloud-platform scope). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never logged. OfficialApiNode does not mint tokens from a service-account JSON.

configurationParameters.label: Version
configurationParameters.description: Default version id for access-secret-version. Default latest.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget (~300s).
